name: Flensing Trap (5-6) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
description: Rotating blades extend from the walls, floors, and ceiling of the surrounding halls when weight is removed from the trapped floor tile.
disable: DC 23 Thievery (expert) to disable the pressure plate

generalAbilities.name: Eviscerate
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Weight is removed from the trapped floor tile

Effect Blades extend from the floor, ceiling, and walls of the surrounding hallways to eviscerate all creatures in the area, dealing (2d10+7) Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw save). Creatures that critically fail also take 1d4 Bleed Damage damage.
